definitions.explanation: A voice conversation over the phone or similar communication device. Used for both the act of calling and the call itself.

examples.japanese: {通話|つうわ}{中|ちゅう}に{電波|でんぱ}が{切|き}れてしまった。
examples.english: I lost the signal during the call.

examples.japanese: このプランは{月|つき}に{百|ひゃく}{分|ぷん}まで{無料|むりょう}で{通話|つうわ}できる。
examples.english: This plan includes up to 100 minutes of free calls per month.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{通話|つうわ} is used in both everyday and technical/business contexts. It refers specifically to voice communication, as opposed to text messaging or data use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通話|つうわ}{料金|りょうきん} (call charges)
- {通話|つうわ}{中|ちゅう} (during a call, on the phone)
- {通話|つうわ}{時間|じかん} (call duration)
- {通話|つうわ}{履歴|りれき} (call history)
- {無料|むりょう}{通話|つうわ} (free calls)
- {通話|つうわ}を{切|き}る (to end/hang up a call)

{通話|つうわ} is the standard word used by phone carriers and in plan descriptions.
